SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id,
  w.word AS word,
  total_synsets,
  total_senses,
  distinct_domains,
  distinct_posids,
  (SELECT s.synsetid FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   GROUP BY s.synsetid 
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC 
   LIMIT 1) AS top_synsetid,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s 
   WHERE s.wordid = w.wordid 
   AND s.synsetid = (SELECT s2.synsetid FROM senses s2 
                     WHERE s2.wordid = w.wordid 
                     GROUP BY s2.synsetid 
                     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s2.synsetid ASC 
                     LIMIT 1)) AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    w.wordid,
    w.word,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM words w
  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid
  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2
    AND distinct_domains >= 2 
    AND total_senses >= 2
) w
ORDER BY
  total_senses DESC,
  total_synsets DESC,
  distinct_domains DESC,
  word_id ASC
LIMIT 500;total 49428

cd /tmp/xhs-c6-host-g_phoqyx; cat > sol.sql <<'EOF'
WITH ws AS (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c, syn.domainid, syn.posid
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
r AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, c, domainid, posid,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY c DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM ws
),
agg AS (
  SELECT wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(c) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN synsetid END) AS top_synsetid,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN c END) AS top_synset_sense_count
  FROM r
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2
)
SELECT a.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word, a.total_synsets, a.total_senses,
       a.distinct_domains, a.distinct_posids, a.top_synsetid, a.top_synset_sense_count
FROM agg a JOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid
ORDER BY a.total_senses DESC, a.total_synsets DESC, a.distinct_domains DESC, a.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
